review_boundary: Original 1311-path staged candidate, excluding changes already present at base. Two explicit working-tree-only documentation amendments were separately rechecked. Their resolution requires those exact amended bytes to replace the original staged documentation before landing.

rules: Preserve reproducibility, attribution and existing compatibility boundary
Workflow: focused changes, tests before behavior changes, do not silently change checkpoint/config formats or weaken source/artifact locks
Do not commit checkpoints, datasets, generated run directories, credentials or machine-local caches; selected reports require documented inputs and generation commands
New third-party code/models/data/actions require provenance, fixed revision/digest and compatible license terms
Applicable publication and CPU numerical validation gates; distinguish CPU proof from fresh GPU/scientific reproduction

method: Every candidate path was matched against exact index bytes and manifest SHA256/size; worktree bytes matched original at initial review
Every staged Python file was structurally read through AST imports/definitions; all staged JSON files parsed; Markdown headings, status/scope assertions and code-block structure inventoried
All implementation/support files were inventoried for domain ownership, test coverage, executable dependencies and prohibited payload forms; selected substantive source hunks manually inspected
Selected retained assertions were compared with their supporting report shape/scope and available pinned receipt; M0 external receipt reopened and rehashed successfully
No independent loss/geometry/metric verifier consolidation proposed; raw viewer payload previews remain excluded

rule.quote: Contributions are welcome when they preserve reproducibility, attribution, and the repository's existing compatibility boundary.

hard_standard_violations.hunk_quote: Waystone has not yet supplied the all-modality local slice, source inventory and measured storage budget. The dedicated Parquet-reader runtime still needs implementation and verification
hard_standard_violations.reason: The new current blockers retracted already established slice/runtime readiness and contradicted the same candidate README lines3-8, dataset lock, retained tracer evidence and independently hashed M0 receipt. This directs researchers away from the documented reproducible execution prerequisites. The staged hunk also removed the mainline viewer entrypoints.
hard_standard_violations.resolution: Amended README lines130-137 state historical delivered slice/live reader proof and keep complete runner/scientific admission open; lines114-126 restore the mainline viewer instructions; lines149-153 identify dispatcher commands as candidate-only. Reviewed amended SHA256 08e79adc36adcb21b7e07948007c9ea83106e08c5db2a840413cebe10cf26d83.

heuristic_smells.status: deferred maintenance observation; frozen-source preservation takes priority
hunk_quotes: if sha(scene_receipt)!=args.expected_scene_receipt_sha256:raise ValueError('trusted native scene receipt differs')
heuristic_smells.reason: Producer-side provenance assembly, stage launching and publication scaffolding are repeated across separately versioned wrappers; the two Motion CLI launchers differ mainly in root/image label and result wording. A future correction to shared orchestration could drift across these sites. This observation excludes independent archive/loss/geometry/metric validation implementations.
heuristic_smells.recommended_disposition: Record the maintenance observation without editing any frozen source. If future maintained versions still require these shared policies, consolidate orchestration only in a separately admitted namespace/version and preserve historical worker bytes for replay. This does not establish a failed live/scientific gate.

scope_assessment.assessment: No additional hard documented-standard violation identified structurally or in selected substantive hunks. Includes source modules, regression tests, launcher/support files and navigation docs. The dispatcher and any partial association/continuation work require their own candidate-specific gates; this Standards review cannot admit them. Frozen-source bytes must remain exact. The duplication observation is deferred.

No hard standards finding. Designs/plans preserve source/runtime/checkpoint identities, distinguish engineering fitting from held-out scientific acceptance and require independent verifiers. Models/training migration remains gated; no new migration implementation is implied.

No prohibited checkpoint/dataset/binary payload candidate identified. Reports preserve status and scientific limits in sampled assertions, including source-only admission, incomplete controller execution and censored outcomes. Evidence families are structurally reviewed; this is not a complete independent replay/admission of all 1135 records.

selected_evidence_checks.scope: report/result metrics vary; only manifest and source receipts are byte-deterministic
independent literal full16 target-index/class assignment audit and uncovered cause analysis; no target or training change

validation_summary.scope: independent literal existing nearest-BEV assignment/forced-match conflicts; no replacement targets, architecture or model inference

selected_evidence_checks.scope: native labels and literal anchor coverage independently admitted; physical measurement support and quality remain open
source admission and pinned live inventory/mirror receipts; scientific native payload processing/publication remain separate gates
recovery inventory only; missing terminal driver output and full checkpoint prohibit admission; preserve partial publication for recovery

landing_suitability.standards: The original staged README is not suitable unchanged. With the two exact reviewed documentation amendments included, there is no outstanding hard Standards-axis finding; source/data/validation readiness remains governed by separate evidence and required gates.
required_followthrough: Replace original staged README/CONTEXT bytes with the exact reviewed amendments before relying on the resolved finding
Retain/check candidate-specific live admission and ownership for each selected landing scope; withhold dispatcher or partial implementations if their gates remain open
Run applicable repository validation gates and keep GPU/scientific limitations explicit
Preserve frozen source inventories, original checkpoints, independent literal-loss/geometry/metric verifiers and historical evidence

limitations: Structural review and selected substantive/evidence checks rather than exhaustive line-by-line scientific audit of 687987 added lines
No live GPU, HDFS, model training, metric execution, branch/index mutation or implementation/refactor occurred
Tooling-enforced whitespace/link checks were excluded from findings
No claims that prior source/hash reports establish the latest source candidate or that all historical records represent current completion
